The issuer appears financially strong, with excellent liquidity (current ratio 2.29), moderate overall leverage (liabilities/assets about 40%), and a large equity base relative to assets. Profitability is also robust, with EBIT of 3,688M on 6,571M of revenue, supporting a high investment-grade view, though the lack of direct debt-service and cash flow detail argues against the very top categories.

DECISION: AA-
